event: "I'll stay until I get bored," Nala says. "And I'm a big fan of spending gold."
She asks for an inn, a meal, a bath, new clothes, a pack, shoes, and someone to make the hide a rug.
Agathe: "You're standing in the inn. Stay and hunt, and the village purse keeps you a week."

memory.fact: If Nala stays to hunt, she'd put her up at the Stag on the village purse for a week.

event: The red-bearded man thumps his chest: "Garrick Pell. Mine's the Stag. Bath's two copper, hot."

memory.fact: Garrick Pell keeps the Tarred Stag, Fenwatch's longhall inn on the green.
He heats water for a wooden tub in the back room; a hot bath costs two copper.

event: No shop here: Bet Ashdown sells clothes; Aldo Brack the tanner makes boots and packs, cures pelts.

memory.fact: Fenwatch has no shop; folk sell what they make from their own doors.
Bet Ashdown, Tobin's mother, sells homespun tunics, leggings and cloaks from her house.
Aldo Brack, the tanner, cures hides in pits by Otter Brook and makes boots, belts and packs.

event: Garrick breaks her gold coin into silver and copper, and she pays him two copper for the bath.

changes.note: Nala pays Garrick two copper for a hot bath

memory.fact: He can break a gold coin into silver and copper from the inn's takings.

event: He sets out goat stew, oat bread and dark ale; she eats every scrap.

memory.fact: He serves eel pie, oat bread, goat stew and turnip mash, and brews his own ale.

event: In a back room Garrick fills a wooden tub with steaming water; she sinks in to the chin.
Clean, warm and fed, she dresses again in the old grey shirt and black tights.
Garrick calls through the door: "Brute's stewing now. Feast on the green at dusk!"

memory.fact: He stews the Brute for a feast on the green on the evening of day one.

event: Tobin shows her the way, talking of how no one believes his tale of the burn.

memory.fact: Tobin can't get anyone in Fenwatch to believe his tale of the Brute and the burn.

event: Bet Ashdown, thin and quick, looks Nala over, then at Tobin, and her mouth goes tight.

memory.fact: Houses are timber and wattle under thick fen-reed thatch, crowded close inside the palisade.
Bet Ashdown is a thin, quick woman of forty, with reed-cut fingers and her son's sunburn.
Tobin has talked of nothing but Nala all afternoon, and it makes his mother wary of her.

event: Nala picks a tunic, leggings and cloak, pays four silver five copper; Bet will fit them by dusk.

changes.note: Nala pays Bet four silver and five copper for tunic, leggings and cloak

memory.fact: Bet has a few tunics, leggings and cloaks made up, and can take them in to fit by dusk.

event: At Otter Brook, sour Aldo Brack measures her bare feet for boots, to be paid on fitting.

memory.fact: Aldo Brack is a stooped, sour man of fifty with stained brown hands, who smells of his pits.
Brack has packs and belts ready; boots he makes to the foot, ready the morning of day three.
Nala has boots on order from Aldo Brack, ready the morning of day three, paid for on fitting.

event: She buys hide foot-wraps tied with thongs for two copper and laces them on at once.

changes.note: Nala pays Brack two copper for hide foot-wraps
Nala buys Brack's hide foot-wraps and laces them on

memory.fact: Until boots are made, Brack sells soft hide foot-wraps tied with thongs for two copper.

event: She takes a leather pack; his price is two silver, but he lets it go for a silver and eight copper.

changes.note: Nala pays Brack a silver and eight copper for a leather pack
Nala buys a leather pack from Brack

memory.fact: Brack's price for a leather pack is two silver.

event: Tobin fetches the Brute's pelt; Brack eyes the hole: "Three weeks. A silver when it's done."

changes.note: Nala hands the Brute's pelt to Brack to cure
Nala leaves the Brute's pelt in Brack's pits at Fenwatch to cure

memory.fact: Brack charges a silver to cure a pelt into a rug or blanket, and it takes him three weeks.
Brack takes a pelt to cure at once and asks his silver when the work is done.
Nala left the Brute's pelt with Brack to cure; she owes him a silver when it is done.

event: At dusk the clothes are ready; tunic and leggings fit, the green cloak falls to her knees.

changes.note: Nala puts on the tunic Bet took in for her
Nala puts on the leggings Bet took in for her
Nala puts on the green cloak from Bet

event: She stows the old grey shirt and black tights in the new pack.
On the green a big fire burns; Garrick stirs a great pot of Brute stew, and the village turns out.
The stew is dark, gamy and tough, and very good after hours of stewing.

memory.fact: Brute meat is dark, gamy and tough, but good stewed long, and Fenwatch would not refuse it.
Stewed long, Sootjaw's tough meat would feed half of Fenwatch.

event: Folk come to thank and stare and ask; she deflects every question back into one of theirs.
A reed-cutter says fen-fever has half his crew abed, and the healer's worn thin.

memory.fact: Fen-fever has taken hold among the reed-cutters this summer, and she is worn thin.

event: Another says the western channels run warm and stink of rotten eggs, with dead fish and yellow reed.

memory.fact: Since spring the western channels run warm and smell faintly of rotten eggs.
Dead fish float in the western channels, and the reed there grows yellow and brittle.

event: An old woman whispers of pale lights in the deep fen at night: "Marsh-ghosts."

memory.fact: Reed-cutters have seen pale lights moving in the deep fen at night, and call them marsh-ghosts.

event: Someone says Osric Fenn the pedlar is due from Wendlow in two days.

memory.fact: The pedlar Osric Fenn is due in Fenwatch from Wendlow in two days.

event: Garrick grumbles that the levy collector comes after harvest: coin, or two young men to march north.

memory.fact: The levy collector comes from Wendlow after harvest for coin, or for two young men to march north.

event: Across the fire, Tobin tells the burn story again to faces that plainly don't believe it.
A tall, stooped woman with cropped white hair and scarred hands stares at Nala a long while.

memory.fact: At the feast a tall, stooped woman with cropped white hair and scarred hands stared long at Nala.
At the feast she Analyzes Nala, sees Human - Level 2, and stares; Nala feels nothing of it.

event: A broad, soot-dark man comes up with a lean grey-green beast in a spiked steel collar at his heel.

memory.fact: Sedge is lean and grey-green, with a lizard muzzle, slanted yellow eyes and a spiked steel collar.
Rowan Coalby is broad and soot-dark, and his words catch when he speaks.

event: "R-Rowan. Coalby. Your Brute took my goats. They b-blamed Sedge. Anything I have, lady, you ask."

memory.fact: Sootjaw took Rowan's goats, and Fenwatch blamed his beast Sedge until the Brute was killed.
At the feast he thanks Nala, stammering, with Sedge at his heel, and offers her any help he has.

event: Far off over the ridge and fen a long howl rises; Sedge lifts its head and answers, low and long.

memory.fact: Its howl carries to Fenwatch on still nights, and Rowan Coalby's Drakewolf answers.

event: Nala sleeps in a small guest room at the Stag, on a straw mattress under a wool blanket.

memory.fact: Nala spent the night of day one in a small guest room at the Tarred Stag, on the village purse.

event: She wakes rested at first light; Garrick sets out bread, an egg and small ale on the village purse.
"Bounty board?" Garrick laughs: "That's in Wendlow, three days east. We've the reeve's slate."

memory.fact: Wendlow, three days east of Fenwatch, has the bounty Board the Fenwatch slate copies from.

event: She reads the slate by the door easily, though she has never seen these letters before.

memory.fact: Fenwatch has no bounty board; the reeve chalks its bounties on a slate by the Stag's door.
She reads the common script as easily as she speaks the tongue, without knowing how.

event: REEDLURKERS at the eel traps: 3 silver a head. GRUBBOARS in the oat strips: 5 silver, old boar.

memory.fact: The slate: reedlurkers robbing the eel traps at the fen edge, three silver a head.
The slate: Grubboars rooting the oat strips south of the palisade, five silver for the old boar.

event: Copied from Wendlow's Board: Ghost-Eye, 25 gold, head; Harl Voss, 30 gold; his men, 2 gold each.

memory.fact: The slate also copies Wendlow's Board: Ghost-Eye, 25 gold; Harl Voss, 30; his men, 2 each.

event: Her boots aren't ready till tomorrow, so she goes looking for the Grubboars.
South of the palisade the oat strips are rooted up; cloven tracks lead into wet alder woods.
A quarter hour through the alders she finds a wallow: five huge-snouted boars asleep in the mud.

memory.fact: By day the Grubboar sounder beds in a wallow in alder carr, a quarter hour south of the oat strips.
Grubboars of Level 12 are huge-snouted boars with a strong back kick, hunted for meat and hide.

event: The old boar is bigger than the rest, grey-bristled and scarred; four sows lie round him.

memory.fact: The Fenwatch sounder's old boar is bigger than the four sows, grey-bristled and scarred.

event: She wills water up out of the wallow into a trembling sphere round the boar's whole head.

changes.note: A water sphere round the boar's head spends a Surge's 10 mana
The boar's water sphere spends 1 water

memory.fact: Her water working can lift water from a wallow into a sphere held round a beast's head.

event: A second sphere closes round the nearest sow's head; two cool, wet, steady pulls sit in her chest.

changes.note: A second sphere round a sow's head spends 10 mana
The sow's water sphere spends 1 water

memory.fact: Holding two water workings, she feels two pulls behind her breastbone, cool, wet and steady.
A water sphere is a working like any other: two at once at rank 1, renewed each minute at full cost.

event: The boar heaves up, bubbles bursting from his snout, kicking back like a mule; the water holds.

memory.fact: When one of a sounder is hurt, the rest charge whoever did it; the boar kicks back like a mule.

event: The other three sows lurch up, find her at the wallow's edge, and charge together.
She lets the sow's sphere go; the freed sow staggers up coughing and joins the charge.
Two at once she can do reliably, so she spends the freed pull on wind and is flung clear.

memory.fact: At legacy rank 1 she can keep two workings going at once; a third makes all of them slip.

event: She runs a wide circle round the wallow in long wind-driven strides; every tusk misses.
Each minute she renews both pulls and feels their draw behind her breastbone.

changes.note: Renewing water and wind each minute drains her mana, netted against its return

event: Within a minute the sows are blowing, their charges slowing to a trot.

memory.fact: A charging Grubboar is fast for a short burst but blows within a minute; wind-speed outruns it.

event: The boar's kicking weakens; he sinks to his knees and falls on his side.

memory.fact: Water held over a beast's head wounds it not; it drops senseless in two minutes and dies in three.

event: Near the third minute he stops moving, and she lets the water fall.
[Prey Eliminated!] [Experience Gained!] [You have leveled up!] [You are now level 3!]

changes.note: The old Grubboar's kill raises Nala to Level 3

event: [+2 Strength] [+2 Dexterity] [+2 Vigor] [+4 Attunement] [+1 Luck]

changes.note: Level 3 grants +2 Strength
Level 3 grants +2 Dexterity
Level 3 grants +2 Vigor
Level 3 grants +1 Luck
Level 3 lifts her greatest health by 5
The level-up fills the new health
Vigor 13 lifts her greatest stamina to 42
The level-up fills the new stamina

event: [Starfall Surge Leveled Up! 1 > 2] [+3 Attunement]

changes.note: Killing the old boar raises Starfall Surge to level 2
Surge level 2 grants +3 Attunement
Attunement 37 lifts her greatest mana to four times it
Level 3 grants +4 Attunement
Attunement 41 lifts her greatest mana to four times it

memory.fact: Killing the old boar raised Starfall Surge to level 2 and her legacy to rank 2, Flare.

event: [Legacy: Starfall has risen to rank 2: Flare]

changes.note: Killing the Level 12 boar at Level 2 lifts her legacy to rank 2, Flare
At Flare each of her element reserves holds 30
Flare deepens her earth reserve to 30
Flare fills the deepened earth reserve
Flare deepens her fire reserve to 30
Flare fills the deepened fire reserve
Flare deepens her wind reserve to 30
Flare fills the deepened wind reserve
Flare deepens her water reserve to 30
Flare fills the deepened water reserve
Flare deepens her electricity reserve to 30
Flare fills the deepened electricity reserve

memory.fact: Killing the Level 12 old boar while she is Level 2 lifts her legacy to rank 2, Flare.

event: [New ability obtained: Starfall Weave. You can hold three workings at once.]

changes.note: At Flare the System grants Starfall Weave at level 1
At Flare she can hold three workings at once

memory.fact: At Flare the System grants her Starfall Weave, and she can hold three workings at once.

event: A warm rush pours through her, bigger than the last; the pressure in her chest seems to deepen.

memory.fact: Her second level-up rush was bigger than the first, and the pressure in her chest seemed to deepen.

event: The four sows stop dead, stare at the fallen boar, then break squealing into the alder carr.

memory.fact: When a sounder's old boar falls, the sows break and scatter into the carr instead of fighting on.
Nala drowned the Fenwatch sounder's old boar in its wallow; the four sows fled into the carr.

event: She lets the wind go, alone in the quiet wallow beside the dead boar.
